summary_en: 43,700 shares (2.67% of S/O ex-treasury) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-21. Upper limit ¥119.9M at closing price of ¥2,744/share. Execution window: single block trade at 08:45 JST. PKSHA Technology signalled willingness to supply shares.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Treasury Stock Purchase via Off-Exchange Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-20, Sapeet Inc.'s board resolved to acquire up to 43,700 treasury shares (2.67% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) via a single off-exchange block trade (ToSTNeT-3) on 2026-08-21 at 08:45 JST. The purchase price is anchored at the closing price of ¥2,744/share on 2026-08-20, with an aggregate upper limit of ¥119.9M. The company stated the shares will be held for potential use as consideration in future M&A transactions or as resources for equity compensation schemes, although no specific deployment timeline or method has been finalized. PKSHA Technology, a shareholder, communicated its intent to supply shares to this transaction. Results will be announced upon completion of the 08:45 trade window.
